name: Parking Spot Memory
description: Save where you parked using Trace glasses voice or photos, then ask where the car is later.

domains.parking_memory: Handle voice commands and active photos for remembering where the user parked their car or vehicle. Example phrases: 'remember that I parked at gate number three', 'save this parking spot', 'take a photo and remember this location', 'where did I park the car', 'find my parking spot', and 'clear all parking memories'.
